description: Search NYC registered and pending contracts with structured filters. Filter by agency, vendor_code, contract ID, date range, amount range, industry, MWBE category, and more. No vendor-name filter (vendor_code only). To find contracts by vendor name: search_spending payee_name, then its contract_id. KNOWN API LIMITATION: registered revenue contracts (category 'revenue') with fiscal_year return no rows from Checkbook NYC (a match count, no records), so the tool refuses that combination without sending a request; omit fiscal_year and filter by dates instead.

agency_code.description: 3-digit agency code, e.g. '056' for NYPD, '040' for Education

category.description: Contract category (default: expense). Fields: registered expense/all use prime_contract_*; registered revenue and pending use plain names (contract_id, purpose).

contract_includes_sub_vendors.description: Sub-vendor flag: 1 = contracts that include sub-vendors. Registered contracts only. Live-verified 2026-07-28. 1 returned 3,246 of 19,139 registered/expense FY2025; 0 returned 0. This is an INTEGER, not a status code — the API rejects a non-numeric value with "is not of data type integer", and it does so as HTTP 200 with a plain-text (non-XML) body, which parses as an empty response. Note the response column of the same name reports 'N/A', so an observed column value cannot be fed back in as a filter value.

include_sub_vendors.description: Include sub-vendor / subcontractor detail columns (sub_vendor, sub_vendor_mwbe_category, sub_contract_current_amount, etc.) in the response. Applies to registered expense/all contracts only; ignored for status='pending' and for category='revenue', whose domains list no sub-vendor columns.

pin.description: Contract PIN / tracking number. Live-verified 2026-07-28. An exact PIN returned exactly 1 record.

purpose.description: Contract purpose keyword (server-side 'contains' match). Live-verified 2026-07-28. purpose='software' returned 168 of 19,139 registered/expense FY2025.

received_date_from.description: Received date range begin (YYYY-MM-DD). Pending contracts only (registered use registration_date). Live-verified 2026-07-28. An open-ended range returned the full pending set.

received_date_to.description: Received date range end (YYYY-MM-DD). Pending contracts only. Live-verified 2026-07-28.

registration_date_from.description: Registration date range begin (YYYY-MM-DD). Registered contracts only. Live-verified 2026-07-28.

registration_date_to.description: Registration date range end (YYYY-MM-DD). Registered contracts only. Live-verified 2026-07-28. A 6-month range returned 9,599 of 19,139.

vendor_code.description: Vendor identification code (the only vendor filter for contracts)

vendor_name.description: NOT SUPPORTED: no vendor-name filter. Use vendor_code. To find contracts by vendor name: search_spending payee_name, then its contract_id.

name: search_contracts
